academic.passage: The study of the human brain has evolved significantly in recent decades. Researchers have identified various regions responsible for specific functions, including memory, emotion, and decision-making. The prefrontal cortex, in particular, is essential for high-level cognitive processes. Continued exploration in this field aims to unravel the complexities of brain activity and enhance strategies for education and mental health.

daily.passage: Attention students: The library will be closed for renovations from July 10th to August 5th. Please plan accordingly and return all materials by July 1st to avoid fines.

questions.q: When will the library be closed?

questions.explain: 學生需在7月1日前歸還所有資料以避免罰款。
